Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below. 

(Left) 617 335 930 459 571 (Right)

(Example-697 - First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (Note: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the first digit of the highest number is added to the third digit of the lowest number?
questions.solution:
The given three-digit numbers are: 617, 335, 930, 459, 571.

Now,

The highest number is 930. Its first digit is 9.

The lowest number is 335. Its third digit is 5.

Perform the addition.

Add the first digit of the highest number 9 to the third digit of the lowest number 5.

9 + 5 = 14.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
